title: Us Iran Ceasefire Declared Strikes Continue May 28 2026
narrative: US and Iranian officials have repeatedly stated that a ceasefire is in effect following three months of conflict, with Secretary of State announcing 'de-escalation achieved' and peace talks ongoing in Doha. The public narrative: the war is paused, negotiations are proceeding, both sides want a deal.
telemetry: BBC timestamped reports (May 28, 05:32 GMT): 'Oil prices jump after US launches new attacks on Iran' — strikes on missile sites and boats, described as 'self-defence'
Iran says it targeted American base AFTER the US strikes (May 28, 11:52 GMT)
Iran reports downing a US drone that 'entered Iranian airspace' — US has not denied this
Strikes occurred WHILE Iranian and Qatari negotiators were in Doha for peace talks (BBC, May 26)
Ceasefire was announced approximately 2 weeks prior per reporting; Iranian internet shutdown ended only days ago

If ceasefire is real, US strikes should have stopped. If ceasefire is real, Iran wouldn't be targeting US bases. The physical evidence (US strike timestamps, Iranian response, drone downing) directly contradicts the diplomatic narrative. Challenge: verify US strike coordinates vs. stated 'self-defence' rationale, cross-reference with flight tracking data (ADSB feeds) showing US military aircraft activity in the region, check commercial satellite tasking for impact sites.
analysis: 'Ceasefire in Progress' vs. 'Strikes Continue' — who's lying, the diplomats or the generals? The public is being told the war is paused while every data point shows kinetic action ongoing. Frame as documentary evidence vs. official statement.
verdict: [SIPHONED VERDICT]: 'Ceasefire in Progress' vs. 'Strikes Continue' — who's lying, the diplomats or the generals? The public is being told the war is paused while every data point shows kinetic action ongoing. Frame as documentary evidence vs. official statement.
